---
title: "Round Tables"
subtitle: "Day 2 working material for benchmark design"
---

The Day 2 morning session turns the workshop discussion into focused material for
a possible BENQODHI paper, report, roadmap or benchmark-repository plan.

Participants should use these documents as working aids. The seed problems are
starting points only; tables are encouraged to propose stronger or more relevant
problems from their own expertise.

::: {.idea-actions}
[Participant guide](participant-guide.qmd){.primary-action}
[Seed problem brief](seed-problem-brief.qmd){.secondary-action}
[Workshop programme](../program.qmd){.secondary-action}
:::

## Documents

### Participant guide

The participant guide defines the scope of the morning, the common transversal
question for all tables, the readiness scale, and the expected output from each
working table.

[Open the participant guide](participant-guide.qmd){.text-link}

### Seed problem brief

The seed problem brief collects candidate scientific problems, benchmark assets
and infrastructure or policy examples. It is intended to support expert judgment,
not to constrain the discussion.

[Open the seed problem brief](seed-problem-brief.qmd){.text-link}

## Table Structure

| Table | Focus |
|---|---|
| 1 | Genomics, molecular biology and life sciences |
| 2 | Medical imaging, diagnostics, machine learning and QML |
| 3 | Mechanistic medicine, clinical decisions and operational optimization |
| 4 | Benchmarking methods and the repository |
| 5 | Infrastructure, community and policy instruments |
